name: Standard Chartered Bank Kenya Limited
source: Standard Chartered Bank Kenya Limited audited consolidated financial results for the year ended 31 December 2025 | CRON r16 (2026-10-12): H1 2026 column is the published half year results of Standard Chartered Bank Kenya for the six months ended 30 June 2026, reproduced identically by four independent Kenyan business outlets, KSh millions scaled to absolute KES: Total operating income 20,138 (H1 2025: 22,086); Net interest income 12,273; Non-interest income 7,865; Operating expenses 10,045; Loan impairment 508; Profit before tax 9,585 (H1 2025: 10,901); Profit after tax 6,727 (H1 2025: 8,087); basic earnings per share 17.58 (H1 2025: 21.18). Operating Expenses stores the printed operating expenses 10,045 plus the printed loan impairment 508, which is 10,553, because Kenyan bank filings present total operating expenses inclusive of provisions and the FY2025 column of this file is on that basis, so total operating income less operating expenses equals the printed profit before tax 9,585 exactly. Income tax 2,858 is printed profit before tax less printed profit after tax. Ties: 20,138 less 10,553 equals 9,585; 9,585 less 2,858 equals 6,727. The column previously held H1 2025 figures: profit before tax 8,087,223, which is the H1 2025 profit after tax, and earnings per share 21.18, the H1 2025 figure.
source_note: Standard Chartered Bank Kenya Limited Annual Report 2025 (basic earnings per share KShs 32.47, prior year 52.65) | https://africanfinancials.com/document/ke-scbk-2025-ar-00 | Operating Profit (EBIT) FY2025 and FY2024 read from the audited FY2025 results announcement, the same column as the stored Profit Before Tax. H1 2026 column from the company filing (https://africanfinancials.com/document/ke-scbk-2026-ir-hy/): revenue, profit after tax and EPS only; other lines blank because the release did not state them. UNIT CHECK: values whose magnitude did not reconcile with the annual column were withheld (filing unit differed from the statement unit); they were not rescaled. UNIT APPLIED: figures converted x1000 from the unit stated in the filing (e.g. Kshs '000). Conversion only where the result reconciles with the annual column.
